notes.path: d4 d5 c4
notes.text: The Queen's Gambit offers the c4 pawn to pull Black's d5 pawn out of the centre. Black usually declines with 2...e6, and White adds pressure on d5 with 3.Nc3.

notes.path: d4 d5 c4 e6 Nc3
notes.text: The Queen's Gambit Declined. White develops the knight to attack d5 and prepares Bg5 after 3...Nf6.

notes.path: d4 d5 c4 e6 Nc3 Nf6 Bg5
notes.text: White pins the f6 knight that defends d5. After 4...Be7, White supports the centre with 5.e3.

notes.path: d4 d5 c4 e6 Nc3 Nf6 Bg5 Be7 e3 O-O Nf3 Nbd7
notes.text: Black prepares ...c6 or ...dxc4. White activates the rook with 7.Rc1, eyeing the c-file.

notes.path: d4 d5 c4 e6 Nc3 Nf6 Bg5 Nbd7
notes.text: Black unpins early and sets up the Elephant Trap if White grabs d5. White safely reinforces the centre with 5.e3.

notes.path: d4 d5 c4 e6 Nc3 c6
notes.text: Black steers towards the solid Semi-Slav triangle. White develops 4.Nf3 to guard d4 and prepare e3.

notes.path: d4 d5 c4 e6 Nc3 c5
notes.text: The Tarrasch Defence attacks d4 from the side. White captures 4.cxd5 so Black is left with an isolated d5 pawn.

notes.path: d4 d5 c4 e6 Nc3 c5 cxd5 exd5 Nf3 Nc6
notes.text: Black's d5 pawn is isolated and has no neighbouring pawn to guard it. White fianchettoes with 6.g3 to target d5 along the long diagonal.

notes.path: d4 d5 c4 c6
notes.text: The Slav Defence supports d5 without blocking the c8 bishop. White develops 3.Nf3 first to stop ...e5 counterstrikes.

notes.path: d4 d5 c4 c6 Nf3 Nf6 Nc3 dxc4
notes.text: Black takes c4 and plans to hold it with ...b5. White plays 5.a4 to stop ...b5 completely.

notes.path: d4 d5 c4 c6 Nf3 Nf6 Nc3 dxc4 a4 Bf5
notes.text: Black gets the bishop out before closing the chain. White plays 6.e3 to recover the c4 pawn with Bxc4.

notes.path: d4 d5 c4 c6 Nf3 Bf5
notes.text: Bringing the bishop out too early leaves b7 undefended. White plays 4.cxd5 followed by Qb3 to attack both b7 and d5.

notes.path: d4 d5 c4 dxc4
notes.text: The Queen's Gambit Accepted. Black gives up the centre, so White claims it immediately with 3.e4.

notes.path: d4 d5 c4 dxc4 e4 e5
notes.text: Black tries to strike back in the centre before White settles. White develops 4.Nf3, eyeing e5 and preparing Bxc4.

notes.path: d4 d5 c4 dxc4 e4 Nf6
notes.text: Black attacks e4 at once. White pushes 5.e5 to drive the knight away and win back c4.

notes.path: d4 d5 c4 dxc4 e4 b5
notes.text: Trying to cling to the c4 pawn with ...b5 fails. White plays 4.a4 to break up Black's queenside pawns.

notes.path: d4 d5 c4 dxc4 e4 c5
notes.text: Black strikes at d4 from the flank. White pushes past with 4.d5 to gain space and keep c4 isolated.

notes.path: d4 d5 c4 Nf6
notes.text: The Marshall Defence lets White take over the centre. White trades 3.cxd5 and pushes 4.e4 after ...Nxd5.

notes.path: d4 d5 c4 Nc6
notes.text: The Chigorin Defence blocks Black's c-pawn. White develops 3.Nc3 to pressure d5.

notes.path: d4 d5 c4 e5
notes.text: The Albin Countergambit gives up a pawn for quick piece play. White takes 3.dxe5 and develops 4.Nf3 after 3...d4.

notes.path: d4 d5 c4 e5 dxe5 d4 Nf3 Nc6
notes.text: White avoids tricks on the e-file and prepares to attack d4. Playing 6.g3 targets d4 with Bg2.

notes.path: d4 d5 c4 Bf5
notes.text: The Baltic Defence brings the bishop out before ...e6. White trades 3.cxd5 and meets ...Bxb1 with Qa4+.
